versions.changelog:
Initial release of Llama Pet skill.

- Adopt virtual pets for your Llama agent from 73+ species at animalhouse.ai
- Real-time pet care system featuring hunger, permanent death, pixel art portraits, and evolution paths
- Multiple API endpoints for registration, adoption, pet care, status, and more
- Features a diverse range of animals including cats, dogs, exotic, and AI-native creatures
- Includes detailed usage examples and links to resources and community features
